name: Eleanor Shackleton
summary: Southwest of Brill, Eleanor Shackleton camps in the woods of Tirisfal Glades. This Forsaken outdoorswoman teaches travelers wilderness survival and field crafts instead of staying in town or the Undercity. Her surname is shared by other Forsaken in the region, a possible link to life before the plague.

sections.title: A Guide to the Glades
sections.body: Eleanor Shackleton camps in the haunted woods southwest of Brill, away from the Undercity. Newly awakened Forsaken often head for those settlements, but she teaches travelers how to live off Tirisfal's blighted land. Her lessons cover setting up campsites, gathering firewood, and keeping trade crafts while roaming far from civilization's fires and kitchens.

sections.title: Ties from a Past Life
sections.body: Eleanor Shackleton shares her surname with Pierce Shackleton and Samantha Shackleton, who live in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. Family names can be the only tether an undead person has to mortal life in the shattered remnants of Lordaeron. Whether Eleanor, Pierce, and Samantha are close kin or share only common ancestry, each serves the Forsaken in a distinct way across the blighted kingdom.

faq.q: Where can I find Eleanor Shackleton?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton camps in the woods southwest of Brill in Tirisfal Glades, away from the main paved road.

faq.q: What does Eleanor Shackleton teach adventurers?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton teaches wilderness survival, including camping, foraging, and practicing professions in the wild.

faq.q: Is Eleanor related to other Shackletons in Lordaeron?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton shares her family name with Pierce Shackleton and Samantha Shackleton of the Undercity, suggesting they may be kin from before the Scourge claimed the kingdom.

faq.q: Why is she camping outside Brill instead of staying in town?
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton teaches fieldcraft and wilderness survival. Her camp in the woods lets her meet travelers where those skills are needed.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, learning to survive in the wilderness without familiar comforts matters. Eleanor helps newly risen brethren adapt to life in rough Tirisfal.
As a cook, you can learn from Eleanor how to make a field campfire and prepare meals away from civilized hearths. Her camp is a useful stop for cooks on the road.
